filter.title: Duotone
filter.desc: Converts to grayscale, then maps shadows and highlights to two brand colors with table lookups.

feFuncR.data-tweak-tableValues: Red of the shadow and the highlight color, 0–1 each

feFuncG.data-tweak-tableValues: Green of the shadow and the highlight color, 0–1 each

feFuncB.data-tweak-tableValues: Blue of the shadow and the highlight color, 0–1 each
